scope: Dealer-only UK integration audit; findings do not approve template releases, real inventory, or deployment.

requiredStockFields: mileage value and original unit or unknown
dealerFacts.currencyRule: GBP is a stock fact, never a conversion inferred from visitor country. Mixed-currency records must preserve their own currency or fail before a family-wide formatter can relabel them.
dealerFacts.distanceRule: Preserve original value/unit; derived canonical km may serve comparisons only. Unknown mileage must not become a zero-mile claim.
dealerFacts.phoneRule: Existing normalizer turns a complete recorded UK domestic 11-digit number into +44 after dropping trunk zero; already international numbers remain as sourced.
dealerFacts.inventoryRule: No fabricated dealer stock, verified badges, current-year defaults, staff, testimonials, finance approval or successful mock enquiry. A sampled dated listing is not owner-confirmed current stock.

workingBoundaries.behavior: Explicit locale contract accepts GB/GBP and enabled en/bg; en-GB belongs in formatter config, not a new route language.
Existing adapter sets en default, GB dealer country, explicit business currency and en-GB formatting without replacing policy.
Existing adapter sets dealerLocaleSettings en/GB/GBP/en-GB and replaces contacts through normalized business facts.
URL > saved cars_locale > weighted Accept-Language > trusted country suggestion > dealer default. Saved country and visitor language do not rewrite business country/currency.

Generated-only trusted hint from event.platform.cf.country; fallback x-cars-country is safe only behind the internal service-boundary router which strips inbound spoofed country headers. Policy remains unchanged.

Native typed facts already retain price currency and original mileage unit. English uses en-GB. Unknown price/mileage can be omitted. Current locale precedence is one valid lang query > signature_locale cookie > dealer locale.

gaps.behavior: Adapter retains original mi text but cards/detail/meta use derived mileageKm and the kilometre-only formatter.
gaps.proposedPatch: Through the existing Auto Best adapter, add typed original value/unit beside canonical km, use a unit-aware presentation helper in existing card/detail consumers, keep unknown blank/request text and leave BG/km behavior intact.
tests: 60000 mi shows 60,000 mi on card/detail/meta; canonical km is 96561
60000 km remains 60,000 km
unknown remains unknown
language choice does not change odometer facts

gaps.behavior: Feed emits mi, native parser strips the unit, then labels the same numeric value km. Card helper also forces km.
gaps.proposedPatch: Extend the existing generated feed with explicit original value/unit and canonical km. Use typed fields at native data boundary and unit-aware card/detail presentation, with exact source guards. Do not solve by changing all km labels to mi.
tests: 60000 mi remains 60,000 mi and compares as 96561 km
96560 km remains kilometre stock
old BG feed without new fields remains supported
null odometer not shown as zero

gaps.behavior: Distance controls and numeric comparisons assume km. Showing mi alone leaves misleading thresholds.
gaps.proposedPatch: Use dealer display unit for threshold labels/input; convert threshold to canonical km exactly once at comparison. Sorting uses canonical km. Preserve original record display even for mixed-unit stock. If a seam cannot be guarded, hold that family rather than silently relabel.
tests: 60000 mi included at 60000-mi limit and excluded below it
equivalent 96561-km record has equivalent comparison
km dealer/filter unchanged
numeric sort orders mixed units correctly

gaps.behavior: Existing adapter marks every personalized record verified, including dated or unconfirmed research.
gaps.proposedPatch: Use the native unconfirmed status unless the source explicitly supplies the existing owner-confirmed verification fact; preserve source URL/date and sample disclosure. Do not infer verification from having a URL.
tests: dated unconfirmed record has no verified claim
explicit permitted verified fact remains intact
sample stock remains clearly sample

gaps.behavior: Legacy priceEur alias receives original amounts. Import textual price parser stamps EUR and rounds. Visible formatted price can still use dealer GBP; mixed currencies and fractional source values cannot safely pass this alias/text seam unchecked.
gaps.proposedPatch: Reuse existing typed factual fields or extend the feed minimally for original nullable amount/currency. Reject unsupported mixed currencies before a dealer-wide formatter; never convert or relabel stock. Retain Price on request for null and exclude it from numeric price claims.
tests: GBP 12345 displays £12,345 without numeric conversion
null remains Price on request
fractional amount is not silently rounded
USD record under GBP dealer remains USD or fails closed

gaps.behavior: Root-owned pending change now preserves tagged mileage, paired flat-field precedence and null request prices in live tests. Missing mileage still defaults to zero and missing year to current year; native consumers need absence provenance rather than adopting defaults as dealer facts.
gaps.proposedPatch: Do not edit the root-owned normalizer here. At existing family adapters inspect supplied raw facts and omit unknown values, as Signature already does, or stop where native type cannot express unknown.
tests: no supplied mileage yields no zero-mile stock claim
no supplied year yields no current-year stock claim
original raw source fact remains available

gaps.behavior: Signature does not currently consume browser language or Cloudflare country; the publisher intentionally skips its hint patch.
gaps.proposedPatch: If cross-family country detection is required, extend this existing resolver/hook in generated output only: valid lang query > saved signature_locale > weighted supported browser language > trusted country suggestion > normalized dealer locale. Use the same internal-only trust boundary; visitor hints cannot alter GBP, GB or original mi. Release approval remains a separate gate.

unsupported browser falls back to trusted hint then dealer
spoofed inbound hint rejected at router
GBP/mi unchanged
one valid lang query persistence and mounted cookie path retained
